content:
AIIMS NORCET 11th Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 – Notification Out | Apply Now

  • Start Date : 24 July 2026
  • Last Date : 13 August 2026
  • Total Posts : 2218
  • Status : Notification Out – Apply Now

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi has released the notification for NORCET-11th Phase (Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test) – Advt. No. 103/2026.

Online application is open from 24 July 2026 to 13 August 2026 for Nursing Officer posts across AIIMS and participating institutes.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date : 24 July 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date : 13 August 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment : 13 August 2026
  • CBT-I Exam Date : 12 September 2026 (tentative)
  • CBT-II Exam Date : 30 September 2026 (tentative)
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC : ₹3000
  • SC / ST / EWS : ₹2400
  • PwD : ₹0

Age Limit (as on 13 August 2026)

  • Minimum : 18 Years
  • Maximum : 30 Years (relaxation as per AIIMS / Govt rules)

Eligibility

Candidates must have B.Sc. Nursing or a Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery with 2 years of experience in a 50-bed hospital and registration with the State/Nursing Council. Check official notification for full details.

Selection Process

  • Stage-I : Pre CBT Exam
  • Stage-II : Mains CBT Exam

How to Apply (Apply Now)

  1. Open https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in
  2. Click NORCET-11 registration / Apply Online
  3. New Registration → fill details → upload documents → pay fee
  4. Submit before 13 August 2026
  5. Keep confirmation page printout

Apply only on official AIIMS exams portal. Read full NORCET-11 notification before applying.
